Welcome to the *Basic Commands* module. In this module, you will take the first steps in your R programming journey by
learning the basics commands that underlie all R usage.

## Learning Goals

After completing this module, you will be able to:

1. Use R to conduct simple mathematical calculations
1. Create simple R objects
1. Conduct simple mathematical calculations involving R objects
1. Conduct simple logical comparisons between R objects
1. Use comments in your code
